properties.name: Devil's Den and Houck's Ridge boulder field
properties.period_note: Natural diabase boulders, present in 1863 and today; the Warren sheet marks the Devil's Den ground with boulder symbols.

sources.cite: Warren, G. K. (survey 1868-69, revised 1873 by P. M. Blake), "Battle field of Gettysburg", scale 1:12,000 (reduced from 1:2,400 original, NARA RG 77 E81). Library of Congress Geography and Map Division, call no. G3824.G3 187- W3 (LC Civil War Maps 353.5), image cw0353500, 8878 x 9845 px JPEG2000
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: Devil's Den and Houck's Ridge labelled on the sheet with boulder (dot and hachure) symbols.

sources.cite: National Park Service, Gettysburg NMP, "Little Round Top Cultural Landscape Report, Treatment and Management Plan" (2012)
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: Plum Run valley and Little Round Top ground covered with loose rocks (the CLR quotes Chamberlain of 6 July 1863).

properties.method: Outline drawn by hand over the Warren-sheet boulder symbols near Devil's Den.
properties.notes: Bare rock: keep modern ground texture here; do not add or remove tree cover from this polygon without separate evidence.
